[[Category: Control Types]]

{{CT|intro

|macro = CT_EDIT
|value = 2
|description = 
An '''edit'''able text '''box''', which allows the user to either enter text himself or to select and copy its content.
|gallery=CT_EDIT.jpg{{!}}Two edit boxes with text. The upper one has some text selected.
CT EDIT code.png{{!}}[[CT_EDIT]] with the [[#autocomplete|autocomplete]] option.
|commands = * [[endl]] (to insert line breaks)
|events =
}}

{{CT|abc start}}
=== A ===
{{CT|attribute
|name=autocomplete
|type1=String
|value1=""
|type2=Number
|value2=0
|description=One of:
* "" (no autocompletion)
* "scripting" (entered text will automatically be completed with matching script command)
* "general" (autocomplete will use some of the last entered words like the chat does)
}}

=== C ===
{{CT|attribute
|name=canModify
|type1=Number
|value1=1
|description=When 0, only (optionally combined with {{Controls|SHIFT}}) {{Controls|LEFT}}, {{Controls|RIGHT}}, {{Controls|HOME}}, {{Controls|END}} and {{Controls|CTRL|C}} can be used
}}

{{CT|attribute
|name=colorActive
|type1=Array
|value1={0.23,0.35,0.42,0.9}
|description=
}}

{{CT|attribute
|name=colorSelection
|type1=Array
|value1={"(profilenamespace getvariable ['GUI_BCG_RGB_R',0.13])","(profilenamespace getvariable ['GUI_BCG_RGB_G',0.54])","(profilenamespace getvariable ['GUI_BCG_RGB_B',0.21])",1}
|description=The text selection highlight color.
}}

=== F ===
{{CT|attribute
|name=forceDrawCaret
|type1=Number
|value1=1
|description=When 1, the caret will be drawn even when control has no focus or is disabled.
}}

=== L ===
{{CT|attribute
|name=linespacing
|type1=Number
|value1=1
|description=
}}

=== M ===
{{CT|attribute
|name=maxChars
|type1=Number
|value1=3
|description=The limit for how many characters could be displayed or entered, counting new line characters too.
}}

{{CT|abc end}}

{{CT|examples}}
=== RscEdit ===
<syntaxhighlight lang="cpp">
class RscEdit
{
	deletable = 0;
	fade = 0;
	access = 0;
	type = CT_EDIT;
	x = 0;
	y = 0;
	h = 0.04;
	w = 0.2;
	colorBackground[] = {0,0,0,0};
	colorText[] = {0.95,0.95,0.95,1};
	colorDisabled[] = {1,1,1,0.25};
	colorSelection[] =
	{
		"(profilenamespace getvariable ['GUI_BCG_RGB_R',0.13])",
		"(profilenamespace getvariable ['GUI_BCG_RGB_G',0.54])",
		"(profilenamespace getvariable ['GUI_BCG_RGB_B',0.21])",
		1
	};
	autocomplete = "";
	text = "";
	size = 0.2;
	style = ST_FRAME; // use ST_NO_RECT to remove the small frame
	font = "RobotoCondensed";
	shadow = 2;
	sizeEx = GUI_TEXT_SIZE_MEDIUM;
	canModify = 1;
	tooltipColorText[] = {1,1,1,1};
	tooltipColorBox[] = {1,1,1,1};
	tooltipColorShade[] = {0,0,0,0.65};
};
</syntaxhighlight>
